name: Rauisuchus
sum: Rauisuchus is a large loricatan archosaur from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: The lectotype is BSPG AS XXV 60-68, 71-100, 105-119 and 121 (including the right premaxilla and postorbital), assigned in 1976; the material was found in 1928 or 1929 by Wilhelm Rau.
material: Bones from the Alemoa Member of the Santa Maria Formation, taken to Germany along with the holotype of Prestosuchus chiniquensis.
biology: The sources consulted describe its discovery and osteology but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Huene 1942
